{"metadata":{"description":"dsh-provider-rate-limit","id":"gh:1343325836","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-provider-rate-limit","slug":"jyao-SUSE-power-group/dsh-provider-rate-limit","topics":["dsh-plugin","dsh-plugin-market","dsh-plugins"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"dsh-provider-rate-limit"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-provider-rate-limit"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Per-provider **&** per-model rate limiting for DeepSeek Harness LLM traffic, plus gateway identity r"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ules (client spoofing) for restricted free-tier gateways."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"适用于 DeepSeek Harness 的按供应商/模型粒度 LLM 限速插件，附带网关身份规则（客户端伪装）能力。"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"- **Token-bucket rate limiting** per `(provider, model)` route — smooth refill with burst support, i"},{"id":"p7s2","text":"dle-time recovery
- **Two modes** when the bucket is empty:
- `wait` — hold the request up to `maxWa"},{"id":"p7s3","text":"itMs`, then let it through (transparent queueing)
- `reject` — short-circuit immediately with a synt"},{"id":"p7s4","text":"hetic `RATE_LIMIT` response carrying `providerRetryAfterMs`
- **Strict FIFO** — reservation-based de"},{"id":"p7s5","text":"sign guarantees same-order admission without polling
- **Gateway identity rules** — rewrite `User-Ag"},{"id":"p7s6","text":"ent` / inject static headers for URLs matching a pattern (e.g. gateways that validate client identit"},{"id":"p7s7","text":"y), with a one-click **OpenCode Zen** preset
- **Master switch** — flip `enabled` off to pass all tr"},{"id":"p7s8","text":"affic instantly, no listener re-registration
- **Settings UI card** — full configuration from the Ha"},{"id":"p7s9","text":"rness settings page, zh/en localized
- **Live stats line** — compact readout in the composer dock (u"},{"id":"p7s10","text":"nder the chat input), SSE-pushed in real time (no polling); hover to see per-route provider·model br"},{"id":"p7s11","text":"eakdown
- **SSE push endpoint** — `GET /api/provider-rate-limit.events` streams a fresh stats snapsh"},{"id":"p7s12","text":"ot every time counters change, with a 15 s heartbeat and automatic reconnection
- **Stats HTTP API**"},{"id":"p7s13","text":" — `GET /api/provider-rate-limit.stats` returns aggregate and per-route counters as JSON (used by th"},{"id":"p7s14","text":"e dock line; also available for external tooling)

- **O(1) route lookup** — pre-built Map for rule matching instead of linear scan

The session is minted once per conversation; a caller-supplie"},{"id":"p22s5","text":"d canonical session is kept, a non-canonical one is replaced. `x-opencode-request` is not sent.

Each call synchronously *reserves* a slot in the route'"},{"id":"p26s3","text":" generation, and compaction). Each call synchronously *reserves* a slot in the route's token bucket:"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"The bucket floor is `now − (capacity − 1) × interval`, which gives classic burst-and-recover semanti"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"cs: after idle time the bucket is implicitly full again, and resizing capacity/rate at runtime never"},{"id":"p28s3","text":" mints a free burst."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"### Upstream 429 backoff"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"### Concurrency limiting"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"When `maxConcurrentRequests > 0`, the plugin additionally gates how many requests to a route may be "},{"id":"p32s2","text":"in flight simultaneously. Requests that pass the RPM check but find all concurrency slots occupied j"},{"id":"p32s3","text":"oin a FIFO slot queue and are granted the instant a predecessor releases — no polling, strict arriva"},{"id":"p32s4","text":"l order. This prevents a burst of parallel agents or subagents from overwhelming a provider even whe"},{"id":"p32s5","text":"n individual RPM limits haven't been reached. `0` means unlimited concurrency (only RPM throttles)."}],"truncated":true}
